Builds everything the later scripts need:

* `food_classification.tsv`: one row per FFQ food with its origin and NOVA group.
* `ffq_frequency_day.tsv`: FFQ answers converted to times/day.
* `diet_scores.tsv`: times/day summed by origin and NOVA group.
* `score_info.tsv`: score names, system and plot labels.
* `analysis_data.tsv`: metadata + ARG metrics + diet scores, one row per sample.

The origin group "mineral or other" only contains salt; it is kept so that every FFQ food is assigned to an origin group.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)

table_dir <- here("1.-FFQ_analysis", "Results", "Tables")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# Data load

```{r data load}
ffq <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "ffq_english.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ffq_dictionary <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "ffq_dictionary.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
arg_metrics <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_metrics.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
nova <- read_excel(here("1.-FFQ_analysis", "NOVA_definitive_classification.xlsx"), sheet = "NOVA")
```


# FFQ to times/day

FFQ answer codes and their frequency in times/day.

```{r frequency}
freq_per_day <- c(
  "1" = 0,        # never or < 1/month
  "2" = 2 / 30,   # 1-3/month
  "3" = 1 / 7,    # 1/week
  "4" = 3 / 7,    # 2-4/week
  "5" = 5.5 / 7,  # 5-6/week
  "6" = 1,        # 1/day
  "7" = 2.5,      # 2-3/day
  "8" = 4.5,      # 4-6/day
  "9" = 6)        # > 6/day

ffq_day <- ffq %>%
  mutate(across(-sample_id, ~ unname(freq_per_day[as.character(.x)])))

stopifnot(!anyNA(ffq_day))
```

## NOVA

Definitive NOVA groups come from `NOVA_definitive_classification.xlsx`. Foods flagged in the justification as
"added back in the sensitivity analysis" are moved to NOVA 1 in the sensitivity classification.

```{r nova groups}
nova <- nova %>%
  transmute(code = Item_code,
            description = Item_description,
            nova = as.integer(NOVA_definitive),
            nova_sensitivity = if_else(str_detect(Justification, "sensitivity analysis"), 1L, nova))

cat("Foods moved to NOVA 1 in the sensitivity classification:\n")
nova %>% filter(nova != nova_sensitivity) %>% select(code, description, nova) %>% print()
```

## Classification table

```{r classification}
food_classification <- ffq_dictionary %>%
  left_join(nova, by = "code") %>%
  left_join(origin, by = "food") %>%
  select(food, code, description, origin, nova, nova_sensitivity)

# Every FFQ food must have exactly one origin and one NOVA group
stopifnot(setequal(food_classification$food, setdiff(names(ffq), "sample_id")),
          !anyDuplicated(food_classification$food),
          !anyNA(food_classification))

count(food_classification, origin)
count(food_classification, nova)
```


# Diet scores

Each score is the sum of times/day of the foods in a group.

```{r scores}
score_groups <- bind_rows(
  food_classification %>% transmute(food, score = paste0("origin_", origin)),
  food_classification %>% transmute(food, score = paste0("nova_", nova)),
  food_classification %>% transmute(food, score = paste0("nova_", nova_sensitivity, "_sensitivity")))

diet_scores <- ffq_day %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "food", values_to = "times_day") %>%
  inner_join(score_groups, by = "food", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(sample_id, score) %>%
  summarise(times_day = sum(times_day), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = score, values_from = times_day)

# Keep only the sensitivity scores that differ from the main classification
unchanged <- str_subset(names(diet_scores), "_sensitivity$") %>%
  keep(~ isTRUE(all.equal(diet_scores[[.x]], diet_scores[[str_remove(.x, "_sensitivity$")]])))
diet_scores <- diet_scores %>% select(-all_of(unchanged))

score_info <- tibble(score = setdiff(names(diet_scores), "sample_id")) %>%
  mutate(system = case_when(str_detect(score, "_sensitivity$") ~ "NOVA (sensitivity)",
                            str_detect(score, "^nova_") ~ "NOVA",
                            TRUE ~ "Origin"),
         label = case_when(system == "Origin" ~ str_to_sentence(str_replace_all(str_remove(score, "^origin_"), "_", " ")),
                           TRUE ~ paste("NOVA", str_extract(score, "\\d")))) %>%
  arrange(factor(system, levels = c("Origin", "NOVA", "NOVA (sensitivity)")), score)

diet_scores <- diet_scores %>% select(sample_id, all_of(score_info$score))
```


# Analysis table

ARG metrics come from `Data/Processed/arg_metrics.tsv` (shared by all parts).


```{r analysis data}
analysis_data <- metadata %>%
  transmute(sample_id, diet_group, sex, age, bmi, reads,
            log10_depth = log10(reads)) %>%
  inner_join(arg_metrics, by = "sample_id") %>%
  inner_join(diet_scores, by = "sample_id")

stopifnot(nrow(analysis_data) == nrow(metadata),
          !anyNA(select(analysis_data, -bmi)))
cat("Samples:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n")
cat("Samples without BMI (dropped from adjusted models):", analysis_data$sample_id[is.na(analysis_data$bmi)], "\n")
```


# Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(food_classification, file.path(table_dir, "food_classification.tsv"))
write_tsv(ffq_day, file.path(table_dir, "ffq_frequency_day.tsv"))
write_tsv(diet_scores, file.path(table_dir, "diet_scores.tsv"))
write_tsv(score_info, file.path(table_dir, "score_info.tsv"))
write_tsv(analysis_data, file.path(table_dir, "analysis_data.tsv"))
```
